notes.title: Our First Month!
notes.content:
It's been just over a month since launch, and some of our players are already outpacing us! We've been hard at work improving visual clarity and reducing ambiguity throughout the game. We've also made several adjustments to better support players retaining upgrades across multiple drops. These changes introduced some unexpected shifts in the gameplay loop, which we've been actively addressing to ensure a smooth and balanced experience.

[h2]Upgrade panel[/h2]
[list]
[*]We've introduced a timer to the upgrade panel. If you don't select an option within the time frame it will pick a random one for you.
[*]We have added icons and text letting you know what kinds of upgrade they are and how long they last for.
[/list]

[h2]Upgrade Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Nerfed Shield upgrade power
[*] Increased bomb recharge time
[*] Increased Beam width upgrade
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dash changes on frame rate
[*] Health bar doesn't go when the game resets
[/list]

[h2]Quality Of Life[/h2]
Weapon shortcut keys - The number keys 1-5 now switch between the collected secondary weapons
Enemy Outline Edge - We have added an edge outline around the enemies to make them more distinct on the planet.

We have made a few difficulty adjustments to account for your new ability to retain upgrades between drops. So now the enemy health increases more agressivly as you progress further. Tentacle and Big Eye Aliens health increased and Upgrades are more sporadic as you progress further.

Please keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: Week 3 Updates
notes.content:
This week we have made some changes to leaderboards and the dash mechanic! These changes were quite time consuming so we haven't added any new upgrades this time around.

[h2]New Dash[/h2]
We have changed the dash to make you invulnerable while you are dashing, this means that you now pass through enemies that would previously have hurt you. We have also resolved a bug that changed your dash length based on your current framerate.

[h2]New Leaderboards[/h2]
Leaderboards have been completely refactored to track most waves survived in one drop rather than the best individual score a player might get. This change is really important as it helps bring focus to both of the competing goals of the game, building a single running score and lasting as long as you can.

[h2]Local Multiplayer Notify[/h2]
We play a small piece of text at the top left corner of the screen to let you know that other local players can join.

notes.title: Week 2 Updates
notes.content:
This week we have been working on adding new upgrades and fixing bugs. We've stripped out a leaderboard awards as we couldn't find a good way to do that at scale.

[h2][h3]New Upgrades[/h3][/h2]
We've added a bunch of new upgrades that offer more playthrough variety

[h3]Random Points - Curse[/h3]
Add or Remove a random number of points between -10,000 and +10,000

[h3]Double Trouble - Curse[/h3]
Gives you an extra (random) upgrade everytime you pick an upgrade

[h3]Remove Points - Curse[/h3]
Removes a certain number of points. There are three levels to this.

[h3]Show Health - Upgrade[/h3]
Adds a health bar to the UI

Let us know if there are any upgrades that you want to see in the game!

[h2][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][/h2]
We've been busy squashing bugs this week to provide a more stable build of the game. 

[list]
[*] Auto Secondary Switching not working
[*] Music doesn't reset sometimes
[*] Music not scaling correctly with enemies
[*] Upgrade drop rate not scaling with upgrade count
[*] Double UI Display
[*] Upgrade doesn't damage the player if it lands on them
[*] Pixelate and camera inverta should be on a timer
[/list]

If you find any bugs or have any issues with the game please post it on the steam forum!

notes.title: Our First Week on Steam!
notes.content:
Our first week has flown by! We've been working hard to improve OBLITACRATER! Thank you to everyone who has bought the game, played the demo and posted feedback. 

Here are some new features that we have added to both the game and demo.

[h2]New Features and Updates[/h2]
[b]Added a Dash meter[/b]
We have added a small dash meter around each player so you can tell when your dash has recharged.

[b]Persistant upgrades[/b]
We've enabled persistnant upgrades on many of the upgrades you unlock. These will now persist between drops for as long as you survive. This means that each time you drop to the planet your ship becomes even more powerful!!!

[b]Localization[/b]
We have added support for multiple languages in game. We now support French, German, Spanish, Korean, Japanese and Chinese. While we are in early access we will be a bit more sporadic in updating languages as the game changes but we will endevour to stay on top of it.

[b]Achievements[/b]
You can now unlock achievements in the game!

[b]Drop Again Button[/b]
We have added a button so you can drop straight back down to the planet rather than having to go back to the main menu.

Please keep the feedback coming! Let us know what you like, don't like. What you'd like to see and whats too OP.
